integrity: Complete derivation and independently implementable rational confluent-divided-difference checks provided; finite tests are not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard simplex, lattice frequencies and its exact zeros are covered; does not assert novel general simplex-transform formula, other simplex shapes, or nonlattice zeros. Earlier literature could contain equivalent classification.
title: Integer Fourier zeros of the standard four-simplex and the first midpoint resonance
